notes.title: The Last Job 2
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

I’m excited to announce that I’m working on my next game! If you enjoyed The Last Job, you won’t want to miss this one. While it’s not a direct sequel, it builds on everything I’ve learned over the past three years. This game is much more polished, with a huge focus on detail, atmosphere, and storytelling.

This time, you’ll step into an entirely new setting—one that seems ordinary at first but hides something far more unsettling beneath the surface. With refined mechanics, a gripping mystery, and a deeply immersive experience, I’ve put everything I’ve learned into making this game as good as it can be.

I’ll be sharing more details soon, but in the meantime, be sure to add the game to your wishlist! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3523590/The_Last_Job_2/
